basics.name: Yi LIU
basics.label: Master's Student
basics.summary: Yi Liu is a master's student at ADMIS Lab, Tongji University, advised by Associate Professor Wengen Li. His research focuses on efficient and controllable diffusion and flow matching models for image restoration, image and video generation, and digital-human motion generation.

education.area: Computer Science and Technology, School of Computer Science and Technology
Computer Science and Technology, College of Electronics and Information Engineering
courses: Admitted to the master's program by recommendation (examination waived)

work.name: ByteDance, GenAI & Ads Infra
work.summary: Efficient generative models and inference acceleration.
highlights: Research on generation efficiency and hardware-aware acceleration.

work.name: Alibaba Cloud, Tongyi Lab (Multimodal Interaction)
work.summary: Long-horizon co-speech motion generation for 3D digital humans.
highlights: Proposed PASPA, a blockwise flow matching model that summarizes history into a persistent state and models current motion with blockwise attention.
Developed long-sequence generation with a fixed-size history state; first-author paper at NeurIPS 2026.

publications.name: Past as State, Present as Attention: Persistent-State Blockwise Flow Matching for Long-Horizon Co-Speech Motion Generation
publications.summary: Yi Liu, Xiangyue Zhang, Jianfang Li, Jia Ma, Yisheng He, and Jianqiang Ren.

publications.summary: Yi Liu, Jia Ma, Wengen Li, Jihong Guan, Shuigeng Zhou, and Yichao Zhang.

publications.name: SADER: Structure-Aware Diffusion Framework with DEterministic Resampling for Multi-Temporal Remote Sensing Cloud Removal
publications.summary: Yifan Zhang, Qian Chen, Yi Liu, Wengen Li, and Jihong Guan. Yi Liu is a co-first author.

publications.name: Effective Cloud Removal for Remote Sensing Images by an Improved Mean-Reverting Denoising Model with Elucidated Design Space
publications.summary: Yi Liu, Wengen Li, Jihong Guan, Shuigeng Zhou, and Yichao Zhang.

projects.name: Controllable Image Restoration via Disentangled Stochastic Interpolants
projects.summary: Project Leader, ADMIS Lab, Tongji University; advised by Associate Professor Wengen Li.
highlights: Proposed DiSI, which separates regression and generation components in stochastic interpolants to reconcile efficient reconstruction with realistic generation.
Developed a single model with inference-time control over the reconstruction–generation trade-off across deraining, denoising, super-resolution, and inpainting.

projects.name: Effective Cloud Removal by an Improved Mean-Reverting Denoising Model
projects.summary: Project Leader, ADMIS Lab, Tongji University; advised by Associate Professor Wengen Li.
highlights: Proposed EMRDM, a modular mean-reverting diffusion framework that directly transforms cloudy images into cloud-free images.
Designed a unified network for mono-temporal and multi-temporal inputs; first-author paper at CVPR 2025, with a released implementation.

projects.name: Efficient Reconstruction for Snapshot Compressive Imaging
projects.summary: Visiting Student, SCI Lab, Westlake University; mentored by Professor Xin Yuan.
highlights: Adapted efficient architectures, including linear attention and state space models, for lower-cost snapshot compressive imaging reconstruction.
Reviewed more than 50 papers and presented a technical report at group meetings.

projects.name: SenseAir: AI-Driven Compressed Air System Management Platform
highlights: Developed a digital-twin platform for compressed-air system operation, maintenance, and optimization.
First inventor of a granted patent, with a registered software copyright.

references.name: Associate Professor Wengen Li
references.reference: Professor Wengen Li is the supervisor of Yi Liu. He is an associate professor at the College of Computer Science and Technology, Tongji University. His research interests include Multimodal Intelligence and Spatial Temporal Data Analysis.
